name: Muha Meds 510 Cartridge | Bahama Berry
description: Bahama Berry is a lively sativa that brings tropical sweetness to every pull. The flavor bursts with juicy berry notes, layered over a light, fruity finish that keeps things fresh and bright. Its tingly, energizing high sparks creativity and focus, making it perfect for daytime vibes or social sessions. Bahama Berry is a go-to for anyone who craves uplifting effects wrapped in a sweet, refreshing flavor profile.
